description: TCEQ New Source Review air permits for electric generating equipment in Texas, statewide, by county, or near a site: company, project, permit number, new facility or renewal/amendment, pending or issued, filed and issued dates, fuel and technology, MW where stated, and a data-center flag. Pending applications come first. Air permits show gas turbines, engines and data-center backup or prime power before projects reach the ERCOT queue or the news. Use for 'new data center air permits in Texas', 'who filed for gas generation in Bexar County this year', 'pending permits near this site', or 'what has Company X filed'. Pro; free accounts see the totals. Free accounts get every location and type; names, sizes, owners and dates are Pro.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

data_centers_only.description: Only permits flagged as data centers.

days.description: Only permits filed or issued in the last N days (alternative to since).

fuel.description: Fuel or technology keyword, e.g. 'natural gas', 'turbine', 'diesel'.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

new_facilities_only.description: Only initial permits for new facilities (no renewals or amendments).

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 25, max 150.

since.description: Only permits filed or issued on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: air_permits
title: TCEQ air permits for generation and data centers
